_source: Phase 3 handoff brief, Section 3 — source of truth for QBO bucket mapping

tiktok.subtract_note: discounts/returns/chargebacks tagged TikTok — same shared accounts as dtc, filtered by Class

amazon.subtract_note: discounts/returns/chargebacks tagged Amazon — same shared accounts as dtc, filtered by Class

ads.note: Confirmed against a live 30-day P&L pull (2026-08-05): Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Amazon Ads, and Marketplace Advertising are all tagged Class='Not Specified', not 'DTC' as previously stated here — none of these accounts are currently split by channel via Class. Paid Collaborations and Affiliate Commissions had zero activity in that period so their tagging wasn't directly confirmed, but presumed to follow the same pattern. Any per-channel ad spend allocation needs a different signal than Class (e.g. per-platform account already exists here, so allocate by account instead).
ads.unallocated_note: Not confidently attributable to one channel by platform name alone (unlike Meta/Google/TikTok/Amazon Ads/Marketplace Advertising, which the business has confirmed map 1:1 to a channel). Excluded from per-channel contribution margin until confirmed with the business; still included in company-wide ad totals via compute_expense_totals.

other_marketing.note: Real per-channel costs that reduce contribution margin but aren't 'ad spend' in the ROAS sense (working paid media) - kept separate from `ads` so ROAS = net_sales/ads isn't distorted by non-working marketing/retention tooling spend. 62300 Creative Agency Fees and 63110 Attribution Tools were considered for this bucket too but the business decided to leave both outside channel-level math for now (2026-08-17) - see excluded_from_v1.

financing.note: Equity/debt financing accounts - excluded from the Cash & Runway tab's operating burn rate. Confirmed live (2026-08-18): two SAFE investments (Harry Lott $25,000 on 2026-07-20, Brad Klontz $25,000 on 2026-08-11) landed in '34000 Additional Paid In Capital' within the trailing 90-day window used for burn/runway, both correctly classified. Left in the raw cash-balance change, this $50,000 of new investment makes operating burn look roughly half what it actually is - it's real cash in the bank, but it's not revenue covering costs, so it shouldn't make runway look longer.

excluded_from_v1.note: Deliberately left out of channel-level contribution margin (treated as overhead), confirmed with the business 2026-08-17. 62300 Creative Agency Fees ($25,556.67 YTD as of that date) and 63110 Attribution Tools ($6,502.50) are real marketing-adjacent spend but not attributed to a channel. 72110 Sales Brokers / Wholesale ($15,000) is likely a real Wholesale-specific acquisition cost by name, but the business chose to leave it out of Wholesale's contribution margin for now rather than guess at the allocation — revisit if Wholesale's true profitability needs scrutiny.
